mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (student_id, password, name, grade, class_name, class_number, register_year, total_coupon, total_point, created_date) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{grade}, #{className}, #{classNumber}, YEAR(NOW()), 0, 30000, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT name, grade, class_name, total_point FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND password = #{password}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT id, student_id AS studentId, name, grade, class_name AS className, class_number AS classNumber, total_point AS totalPoint, total_coupon AS totalCoupon FROM students ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY total_point DESC, student_id ASC) AS `rank`, student_id AS studentId, name, grade, class_name AS className, class_number AS classNumber, total_point AS totalPoint FROM students ORDER BY total_point DESC, student_id ASC LIMIT 100
